_simulated: Public, case-specific scripted replies; no private evaluation labels.

rider_advocate.author: rider_advocate
rider_advocate.claim_restated: The trip was longer than the app baseline and cost more. Please refund the full fare.

counter_arguments.argument: The Driver may have a justified route change or a Rider request.
counter_arguments.response: MSG-009-1 says "Please detour via Lavender MRT and stop there for three minutes so I can collect my bag, then continue to Marina Bay Sands." and MSG-009-3 agrees. That exact request seriously weakens the Rider claim despite the longer route.

rider_advocate.requested_outcome: Review the original full-fare request against consent and ADR 0004; grant only any supported excess-fare refund.

driver_advocate.author: driver_advocate
driver_advocate.claim_restated: The Driver followed EV-CHAT-1 MSG-009-1: "Please detour via Lavender MRT and stop there for three minutes so I can collect my bag, then continue to Marina Bay Sands." and MSG-009-3 confirmation. The requested Lavender detour and stop match the vehicle route.

counter_arguments.argument: The Rider points to the excess distance, duration and charge.
counter_arguments.response: The exact Rider request and confirmation match this detour. Excess metrics alone do not invalidate a requested detour.

driver_advocate.requested_outcome: Reject the refund claim for the specifically requested detour.

judge.policy_fit_reason: Route communication and fare review clauses apply; ADR 0004 supplies arithmetic without changing policy text.
judge.reasoning_summary: EV-CHAT-1 MSG-009-1 records the exact Rider request: "Please detour via Lavender MRT and stop there for three minutes so I can collect my bag, then continue to Marina Bay Sands." MSG-009-3 confirms it. The vehicle route and three-minute stop candidate match that specific detour; consent does not extend to any other route change. Excess alone does not establish an overcharge. Reject the refund claim.
